<h2 class="section-title">India National Politics</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>INDIA bloc protest:</strong> Following the Chief Justice of India&#x27;s refusal to meet with the opposition coalition regarding election grievances, the INDIA bloc has announced plans to march to the Supreme Court.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMisgFBVV95cUxOT1Bjc05wblFrY2puQmxDTE1hSEc0cTVYUkNUUEhnanZ3X1JWYXhBdXJ2aHZaMjc5V3hXN2E2Vzlwd3Qzdm85RTJ6bW5RQkNKMnczRFg5VGVWSXZVNTVoYzdZLVdpREtLVVdIOEhyQ29tQmFBNUVRMExvaHE0N2NuUkdHdmROQnNvemtYQWNuM0tHbEQyZnVqcHNYREFXSVI4NUEyUW92d2ViNjZWTGt1dUdB?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I2</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I3</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Government response to UN:</strong> The Union government has criticized the UN rights body for allegedly applying double standards regarding India&#x27;s internal affairs.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I8</a></span></li>
</ul>

<ul class="digest-points">

  <li><strong>Inter-party tensions:</strong> AAP and BJP have traded accusations following a confrontation involving Delhi Police at a gurdwara, highlighting ongoing friction over religious and political conduct.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMi-?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W8</a></span></li>
